verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.column.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Column Documentation header). The documentation is also served as clean markdown under /markdown/ paths, and a machine-readable OpenAPI JSON is available, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on using the docs with AI agents, and evidence of fuller agent bundles such as llms-full.txt.
